new_findings.defaults_are_not_pilot: Absent resolved model/data values, inspected defaults are Qwen/Qwen3-0.6b and mlx-community/WikiSQL, not the owner proposed local trainable model and gold data. Neither was acquired or loaded.
new_findings.no_train_is_not_dryrun: The pinned run function places model and dataset loading before train/test branch checks; never invoke upstream main/run merely to validate future arguments.
new_findings.launch_flag_not_framework_enforced: launch_allowed=false is our documentary gate. The inspected framework run does not check it, and a predecoded config train=true remains true after merge.
new_findings.none_only_merge: Config overrides only namespace entries equal to None. CLI trust_remote_code False and clear_cache_threshold0 therefore prevent corresponding config values from replacing them.
new_findings.config_types_not_parser_validated: Predecoded config iters string and fine_tune_type qlora survive the shown merge. This does not claim downstream trainer acceptance; the shown train_model validates fine_tune_type later.
new_findings.lora_parameters: Nested rank/dropout/scale belong to configuration, not an invented --rank option.
new_findings.unknown_converter: No source/unit claim for _parse_size; use of that flag blocked in this audit.
new_findings.mask_prompt: Admission of mask_prompt=true is not tokenizer/mask correctness; prior unresolved padding/zero-supervision findings remain.

future_owner_review_requirements: Resolve exact approved trainable model/tokenizer/environment/source/data manifests before constructing a real run request.
Validate the final merged configuration with explicit types,allowed choices and positive bounded budgets;do not rely on argparse for configuration-file values.
Keep prelaunch authorization/resource/isolation checks outside upstream run and enforce them before any possible model/data loading.
Separately review unknown converter/YAML/tokenizer semantics and actual memory feasibility.
Do not emit or execute a launch command until all nine readiness gates and owner-specific training approval are satisfied.
pure_selected_source_function_executed: build_parser only,strictly reviewed stdlib argument construction. This is a new scoped follow-up beyond earlier static-only framework review.
